title: Speaking — Travel memories
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on travel memories.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
What do you normally remember first about a trip?
Do you like looking back at routes you once travelled?

part2.topic: Describe a journey you remember because of the people you met.
part2.closing: and explain why the people mattered more than the destination.

questions: What kinds of travel encourage conversations among passengers?
How should a destination manage tourism that changes local daily life?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to travel memories?
